newsitem.title: USA: Gull Labs in pact to buy Fresenius unit.
newsitem.headline: Gull Labs in pact to buy Fresenius unit.

text.p: Gull Laboratories Inc said it signed an agreement to acquire the diagnostics business of the Intensive Care and Diagnostics Division of Fresenius AG .
Gull said Fresenius AG will receive 1.32 million shares for the diagnostics business, increasing Fresenius' stake in Gull 62 percent from 55 percent.
Gull said it received an independent fairness opinion from Vector Securities for the transaction.

Gull said Fresenius Diagnostics had sales of about $8.3 million in 1996. Gull recorded sales of $17.9 million in 1996, of which 37 percent were achieved in Europe, where Fresenius Diagnostics recorded all its sales.
